explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 79 named tracks across Clone's live current/pre-order/catalogue field, Boomkat and Bandcamp current electronic releases, and targeted exact-track source checks. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Completed Runs 214, 217, 218, 219 and 221 selected identities and source fields were excluded; unresolved, duplicate, rejected and untriggered PARKED identities were not reused.

Every exact artist/title pair below was checked against the canonical ledger, discoveries, target-local discovery pool, active rejections, PARKED revisit queue and global utility ledger before ranking; none was present.
The repetition check compared the previous five completed discovery runs (214, 217, 218, 219 and 221). None of the nine placements repeats a selected-candidate boundary from those runs.

The Run 220 temporary evidence guard closed in Run 221. Even so, all nine leads are distinct exact identities; the three strongest slots come from three releases and carry candidate-specific descriptions.

Nine honest leads survived without padding. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and both protected handoffs remain untouched. No Spotify connector, raw audio, invented identity or metadata-to-feeling inference was used.
